summary: Frontend-only render verification for 3 new features (MRR Celebration status, Ladder Trend 14-day chart, EOD Report card) plus regression on Morning Karne. All expected data-testids render with correct content; safe click actions (eod-send-now, pa-celebration-check) both produced the expected Turkish toast messages.
action_items: Low priority: PlatformAdminPanel emits React warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' during render. Add stable keys where a list is mapped in PlatformAdminPanel.js.
critical_code_review_comments: PlatformAdminPanel: missing key prop in a list render (React console warning). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: None. Triggered eod-send-now (idempotent/forced per instructions) which added history rows; pa-celebration-check was a safe read-only call (target not exceeded, no dedupe row written).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation: after login click [data-testid=nav-mode-pro] to enter PRO. Morning Karne: Revenue management sidebar section auto-includes it; [data-testid=morning-karne-btn] opens [data-testid=morning-karne-panel]. New elements verified: ladder-trend-chart (3 .recharts-line elements = kurtarılan/ek gelir/toplam), eod-report-card, eod-preview (container with 5 boxes: %40 Doluluk / £0 Gelir / 3/2 Giriş-Çıkış / 0 No-show / 3 Yarın giriş), eod-last-sent ('Son gönderim: 2026-08-25 → 1 yönetici'), eod-send-now-btn → toast 'Gün sonu raporu gönderildi → 1 yönetici'. Regression: karne-grade=B, karne-checks children=9, ladder-weekly-card intact. PlatformAdminPanel: nav via [data-testid=super-admin-btn] (bottom of sidebar in SETTINGS & ADMIN; use JS scrollIntoView because it is far down). Verified pa-celebration-status text 'Hedef aşılınca otomatik kutlama bildirimi + e-postası gider' and pa-celebration-check click → toast 'Hedef henüz aşılmadı: £1990 / £2500' (celebration NOT triggered as expected; MRR £1990 < target £2500).
rca of the issue: N/A – no bugs found. Only a low-severity React key-prop warning in PlatformAdminPanel.
